blocks.text: be fe'lining o'tgan zamoni: was, were

1-darsda **be** fe'lining hozirgi shakllarini (am, is, are) o'rgandik. O'tmish haqida gapirganda ham inglizcha gapda fe'l bo'lishi shart, shuning uchun **be** o'tgan zamon shakliga o'tadi: **was** yoki **were**. O'zbekchada uning eng yaqin mosi — «**edi**»: Men uyda **edim** — I **was** at home; Kecha havo sovuq **edi** — It **was** cold yesterday. O'zbekchada «uyda**man**» → «uyda **edim**» bo'lganidek, inglizchada **am** → **was** bo'ladi.

rows: She **was** at work. — U ishda edi.
They **were** in Bukhara. — Ular Buxoroda edi.

blocks.text: Tanlash qoidasi: **am** va **is** → **was**; **are** → **were**. Demak, **I** va bitta kishi yoki narsa (he, she, it, my father, the film, London) bilan — **was**; bir nechta kishi yoki narsa (we, they, my friends, the shops) va **you** bilan — **were**. **you** bitta kishiga gapirganda ham doim **were** bilan keladi: you **were**, hech qachon «you was» emas.

O'zbekchada o'tmishdagi holat har xil aytiladi: «edi» (U kasal **edi**), «-gan» (Bobom shifokor **bo'lgan**), «bo'ldi» (Konsert qanday **o'tdi**?). Inglizchada bularning hammasi bitta **was / were** bilan ifodalanadi — shuning uchun tarjimada bir xil inglizcha gap turlicha chiqishi mumkin. Asosiysi: gap o'tmish haqida va unda boshqa fe'l bo'lmasa, **was / were** kerak.

was / were ko'pincha o'tgan vaqtni bildiruvchi so'zlar bilan keladi. Ularning ba'zilari o'zbekchadan farq qiladi: «kecha kechqurun» — **last night** («yesterday night» emas); «o'tgan hafta» — **last week** (oldida the yoki in qo'yilmaydi). **ago** («... oldin») doim vaqtdan keyin turadi: two days **ago** — ikki kun oldin (batafsil — 19-darsda).

rows: kecha / kecha ertalab / kecha tushdan keyin
ikki kun oldin / bir yil oldin

blocks.text: Inkor gap hozirgi zamondagidek quriladi: **was / were** dan keyin **not**. So'zlashuvda deyarli doim qisqa shakl ishlatiladi: was not → **wasn't**, were not → **weren't**. O'zbekchada bunga «emas edi» («emasdi»), joy haqida gapirganda esa ko'pincha «yo'q edi» mos keladi: He **wasn't** at home — U uyda **yo'q edi**.
Savol va qisqa javob: Was ...? Were ...?

Savol tuzish uchun **was / were** egadan oldinga chiqadi — xuddi 2-darsdagi Are you ...? kabi: you **were** → **Were** you ...? O'zbekchada so'z tartibi o'zgarmaydi, faqat **-mi** qo'shiladi: «Uyda edingiz**mi**?». Qisqa javobda faqat ega va **was / were** qoladi: Yes, I **was**. / No, it **wasn't**.

So'roq so'zli savollarda tartib: **so'roq so'zi + was / were + ega**: Where **were** you? Why **was** she late? What time **was** the train? Ayniqsa **How was ...?** juda ko'p ishlatiladi — «... qanday o'tdi?», «... qanday bo'ldi?»: How **was** your trip? — Safaringiz qanday o'tdi?

items.text: **Were** you at the gym yesterday? — No, I **wasn't**.

blocks.text: O'zbekcha «tug'ilganman» inglizchada **was born** / **were born** bo'ladi: I **was born** in 1998. **born** doim **be** bilan keladi, shuning uchun «I born» yoki «I am born» deyilmaydi. Savol ham **was / were** bilan: Where **were** you **born**? When **was** your son **born**?

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I born in Tashkent.» → I **was born** in Tashkent.; «You was late.» → You **were** late. (you — doim were); «Yesterday I am tired.» → Yesterday I **was** tired. (o'tgan vaqt — o'tgan zamon fe'li); «Where you were?» → Where **were** you? (savolda were egadan oldin); «yesterday night» → **last night**.
Eslab qolish: **am, is → was**; **are → were**. Qaysi shaklni tanlashda ikkilansangiz, gapni avval hozirgi zamonda ayting: they **are** → they **were**, my brother **is** → my brother **was**.

Boshqa fe'llarning o'tgan zamoni (worked, went) — 11-dars; ularning inkori va savoli (didn't, Did ...?) — 12-dars. **was / were + -ing** (I was reading) — 13-dars. **there was / there were** — 38-dars.

examples.title: I / he / she / it **was**
examples.description: **I** va bitta kishi yoki narsa bilan — **was**. O'zbekchada ko'pincha «edi», ba'zan «-gan»: Buvim o'qituvchi **bo'lgan**.

sentences.text: **I was** at home all day yesterday.
The film **was** really funny.
My grandmother **was** a teacher for thirty years.
Last night it **was** very cold in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun Samarqandda havo juda **sovuq edi**.

sentences.text: Sorry, **I was** in the shower.
Aziz **was** ill on Monday, so he **was** at home with his mum.
sentences.translation: Dushanba kuni Aziz **kasal edi**, shuning uchun onasi bilan **uyda edi**.

sentences.text: The weather **was** lovely in London last week.
My first car **was** old and small, but it **was** very reliable.
sentences.translation: Birinchi mashinam eski va kichkina **edi**, lekin juda **ishonchli edi**.

sentences.text: When I **was** a child, my favourite food **was** plov.
Emma **was** tired after the long journey from Oxford.
sentences.translation: Oksforddan uzoq yo'l bosib kelgach, Emma **charchagan edi**.

examples.title: We / you / they **were**
examples.description: Ko'plik va **you** (sen, siz, sizlar) bilan — **were**. you bitta kishiga gapirganda ham **were** bilan keladi.

sentences.text: **We were** at the cinema last night.
**You were** right about the restaurant.
My parents **were** in Bukhara for the holidays.
The streets **were** empty early in the morning.
Tom and James **were** in the same class at school.
sentences.translation: Tom bilan Jeyms maktabda bir **sinfda o'qishgan**.

sentences.text: Those shoes **were** cheap, but they **were** very comfortable.
sentences.translation: U poyabzal **arzon edi**, lekin juda **qulay edi**.

sentences.text: The tickets **were** twenty pounds each.
Dilnoza, **you were** wonderful at the concert yesterday!
Our neighbours **were** on holiday, so their flat **was** quiet.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz **ta'tilda edi**, shuning uchun ularning kvartirasi **jim-jit edi**.

sentences.text: The questions in the exam **were** easy, but we **were** nervous.
sentences.translation: Imtihondagi savollar **oson edi**, lekin biz **hayajonda edik**.

examples.title: Yesterday, last week, in 2018: past time words
examples.description: **was / were** o'tgan vaqtni bildiruvchi so'zlar bilan: yesterday, last night, last month, two days ago, in 2018, when I was a child.

sentences.text: Yesterday **was** Sunday, so the shops **were** busy.
sentences.translation: Kecha **yakshanba edi**, shuning uchun do'konlarda **odam ko'p edi**.

sentences.text: Last month I **was** in Manchester on business.
sentences.translation: O'tgan oy xizmat safari bilan **Manchesterda edim**.

sentences.text: Two days ago the weather **was** warm and sunny.
sentences.translation: Ikki kun oldin havo iliq va **quyoshli edi**.

sentences.text: My brother **was** a student in Oxford in 2018.
Yesterday afternoon we **were** at Grandma's house.
Last summer **was** very hot in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yozda Toshkentda havo juda **issiq edi**.

sentences.text: At eight o'clock this morning I **was** still in bed.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab soat sakkizda hali **to'shakda edim**.

sentences.text: In 2010 Madina and Bekzod **were** only little children.
sentences.translation: 2010-yilda Madina bilan Bekzod hali **kichkina bola edi**.

sentences.text: On Saturday the museum **was** closed, so we **were** in the park.
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni muzey **yopiq edi**, shuning uchun biz **parkda edik**.

sentences.text: When my father **was** young, he **was** a good football player.

examples.title: Negative: **wasn't** / **weren't**
examples.description: Inkor — **was / were** dan keyin **not**; so'zlashuvda qisqa shakl: **wasn't**, **weren't**. O'zbekchada: «emasdi», joy haqida — «yo'q edi».

sentences.text: **I wasn't** at work yesterday — I **was** ill.
The hotel **wasn't** expensive, and the rooms **were** clean.
My best friends **weren't** at the wedding on Saturday.
sentences.translation: Shanba kungi to'yda eng yaqin do'stlarim **yo'q edi**.

sentences.text: It **was not** a difficult test, but it **was** very long.
Sarah **wasn't** happy with her exam results.
We **weren't** late — the train **was** late!
The shops **weren't** open because it **was** a holiday.
Last year Bekzod **wasn't** a very good student, but now he's the best in the class.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili Bekzod unchalik yaxshi **o'quvchi emasdi**, endi esa sinfdagi eng zo'ri.

sentences.text: Those apples **weren't** sweet, they **were** sour.
Tom **wasn't** at the meeting, and his phone **was** off all day.
sentences.translation: Tom yig'ilishda **yo'q edi**, telefoni ham kun bo'yi **o'chiq edi**.

examples.title: **Was** it ...? **Were** you ...? — short answers
examples.description: Savolda **was / were** egadan oldin turadi. Qisqa javob: Yes, I **was**. / No, they **weren't**.

sentences.text: **Were** you at home last night? — Yes, I **was**.
**Was** the exam difficult? — No, it **wasn't**.
**Was** Madina at school today? — No, she **wasn't**. She **was** ill.
sentences.translation: Bugun Madina maktabda **edimi**? — Yo'q, **yo'q edi**. U kasal edi.

sentences.text: **Were** your parents in Samarkand last weekend? — Yes, they **were**.
sentences.translation: O'tgan dam olish kunlari ota-onangiz **Samarqanddamidi**? — Ha, **o'sha yerda edilar**.

sentences.text: **Was** the hotel near the beach? — Yes, it **was**, just two minutes away.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona sohilga **yaqinmidi**? — Ha, **yaqin edi**, atigi ikki daqiqalik yo'l.

sentences.text: Tom, **were** you nervous before the interview? — A little, yes.
sentences.translation: Tom, intervyu oldidan **hayajonda edingmi**? — Ha, ozgina.

sentences.text: Sorry, **were** you busy? — No, I **wasn't**. Come in!
And the food? **Was** it good? — Oh yes, it **was** delicious!
So **were** the tickets expensive? — No, they **weren't**. Only ten pounds.
sentences.translation: Xo'sh, chiptalar **qimmatmidi**? — Yo'q, **qimmat emasdi**. Atigi o'n funt.

sentences.text: Dilnoza and Aziz, **were** you at the lesson yesterday? — Yes, we **were**.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza, Aziz, kecha darsda **edingizmi**? — Ha, **darsda edik**.

examples.title: Where **were** you? How **was** it?
examples.description: So'roq so'zi + **was / were** + ega. **How was ...?** — «... qanday o'tdi?»: safar, dam olish, imtihon haqida so'rashning eng oddiy yo'li.

sentences.text: Where **were** you at seven o'clock this morning?
How **was** your holiday in Bukhara? — It **was** great!
Why **were** you late for the lesson?
How **was** the weather in London?
Who **was** your first English teacher?
How much **were** the tickets for the concert?
Where **was** Emma yesterday? — She **was** at her cousin's wedding.
Why **was** the shop closed on Friday?
What time **was** your train? — It **was** at half past six.
Which hotel **was** the best, the first or the second?
sentences.translation: Qaysi mehmonxona **eng yaxshisi edi** — birinchisimi yoki ikkinchisi?

examples.title: **was born**; then **was**, now **is**
examples.description: «Tug'ilganman» — **was born** («I born» emas). Hozir va o'tmishni yonma-yon qo'yish: now **is** — then **was**, this year **are** — last year **were**.

sentences.text: **I was born** in Tashkent in 2001.
Where **were** you **born**? — In a small town near Fergana.
My grandfather **was born** in 1940, and he's still very active.
Shakespeare **was born** in Stratford-upon-Avon, not in London.
Now I'm a doctor, but ten years ago I **was** a student.
sentences.translation: Hozir shifokorman, o'n yil oldin esa **talaba edim**.

sentences.text: Twenty years ago this street **was** quiet, but now it's very busy.
sentences.translation: Yigirma yil oldin bu ko'cha **tinch edi**, hozir esa juda gavjum.

sentences.text: Today is sunny, but yesterday **was** cold and windy.
sentences.translation: Bugun quyoshli, kecha esa havo **sovuq va shamolli edi**.

sentences.text: My sister is a nurse now; before that she **was** a waitress.
sentences.translation: Opam hozir hamshira, undan oldin esa **ofitsiant edi**.

sentences.text: The tickets are expensive this year, but last year they **were** cheap.
sentences.translation: Bu yil chiptalar qimmat, o'tgan yili esa **arzon edi**.

sentences.text: James **was born** in Scotland, but now he lives in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Jeyms Shotlandiyada **tug'ilgan**, lekin hozir Manchesterda yashaydi.

examples.title: Dialogue: How **was** your weekend?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: **was / were**, inkor va savol jonli suhbatda. «You weren't at the party» ga «No, I wasn't» — o'zbekchada «To'g'ri, yo'q edim».

sentences.text: — Hi, Sarah! How **was** your weekend?
sentences.translation: — Salom, Sara! Dam olish kunlaring **qanday o'tdi**?

sentences.text: — It **was** fantastic, thanks. I **was** in Oxford with my sister.
— Oh, nice! **Was** the weather good there?
— Yes, it **was** warm and sunny on both days.
sentences.translation: — Ha, ikkala kun ham iliq va **quyoshli edi**.

sentences.text: — And where **were** you? You **weren't** at Tom's party.
— No, I **wasn't**. I **was** at home with a bad cold.
— Oh no! **Were** your parents at home too?
— No, they **were** in Bukhara at my uncle's house.
— So who **was** at the party? **Was** it fun?
— It **was** OK, but the music **was** too loud for me.
sentences.translation: — **Yomon emasdi**, lekin musiqa men uchun juda **baland edi**.
